questions.question: Explain why plants, and therefore animals and people, need the Sun's light.
questions.expected_answer: Plants need sunlight to make their own food in their leaves. Without light, they cannot make food and they die. Animals and people eat plants, or eat animals that ate plants, so we all depend on the Sun's light for our food.

questions.question: Explain why a lizard lies on a rock in the sun in the morning.
questions.expected_answer: A lizard cannot make its own body heat. On a cold morning, its body is cold, so it is slow. It lies on a sunny rock to warm up with the Sun's heat, so that it can move fast and catch food.

questions.question: Name three ways people use the Sun and two ways to stay safe in the sun.
questions.expected_answer: Ways to use the Sun, any three: drying fruit like raisins, drying washing, making salt, making electricity with solar panels, heating water with solar water heaters, cooking in solar cookers. Ways to stay safe, any two: wear a hat, use sunscreen, drink plenty of water, stay in the shade at midday.
